title: Mainsah et al. 2025 — bigP3BCI: An Open, Diverse and Machine Learning Ready P300-based Brain-Computer Interface Dataset (Study Q)
description: Study Q of the bigP3BCI collection, comprising EEG recordings from 36 participants across three sessions each, using a 6x6 character grid P300 speller with color intensification. The recordings were acquired with a 32-channel g.USBamp system at 256 Hz, with target and non-target stimulus events annotated using HED. The dataset is part of a large, machine-learning-ready P300 brain-computer interface collection and supports calibration-then-test evaluation of P300 detection.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a g.tec g.USBamp amplifier from 32 channels placed according to the standard 10-20 montage, sampled at 256 Hz. Participants used a 6x6 P300 speller grid with color intensification, with online feedback, in a laboratory setting. Events are labeled Target and NonTarget, with epochs spanning 0-1.0 s after stimulus.
